title: 第11章 满载凯旋第12章 圣城看灵田
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 觅仙城，沈云一晚上没睡。
一边运转呼吸法，一边留意附近的风吹草动。
随时准备带苏婉儿跑路。
谁知第二天一早，风家府宅大开，众人凯旋归来。
身后跟着一辆辆马车，运载从黄家搜刮的金银。
一个家族的积累，折合起来能有数百万两的资产。
家主大手一挥，风府上下仆人护院，最少得了十两银子的赏钱，多的五百两。
沈云和风家四爷在账房发钱，一上午忙的脚不沾地。
沈云也得了赏钱，他和苏婉儿共得三百两，他二百，苏婉儿一百。
热热闹闹一上午后，他感觉有些不真实。
潜龙山脉结束了！
城内几大世家和城主府握手言和！！
以后城内或将以风家为尊！！？
消息一个比一个炸裂。
觅仙城内，从风家大小姐一剑灭黄家，传成了风洛依吹口气黄家尽数而亡。
越传越邪乎。
不过不论传成什么样，风家都是潜龙山脉一行最大的赢家。
“变化太大了，大小姐回来了，这么强吗？”
沈云打听到了昨晚的详细经过，还有些不可置信。
剑指七大老祖，一剑灭血海！
想起风洛依，沈云不自觉看向账房的角落。
以前她喜欢听沈云讲故事，从寓言故事到他魔改的洪荒神话故事。
十五年前那个坐在角落，安安静静听他讲故事的小女孩，竟然到了此等境地。
人家十五年干了啥，他十五年干了啥？
四爷走后，沈云迫不及待的来到对面，找风老头打听确认。
“风老头，大小姐.....”
结果推开门却发现，风老头呆坐在那里，老泪纵横。
“...这是怎么了？”
整个人好似又苍老了十岁，原本的灰发全白，满脸的疲倦和悲伤遮掩不住。
“老沈，小天废了，修为废了，骨骼碎了三分之一，终生都站不起来了！”
风老头眼神呆滞，口中呢喃着。
“什么！风天他....”
沈云想到了憨厚老实的风天，小时候还抱过他，给他讲过志怪传说故事。
风天后来成了修士，当上了小队长，也一直对他很尊敬。
content_en:
In Xixian City, Shen Yun didn't sleep all night.
While practicing the breathing method, pay attention to the surroundings.
Be ready to take Amelia Su away at any time.
Unexpectedly, early the next morning, the Feng family mansion was opened and everyone returned in triumph.
Behind him were carriages carrying gold and silver looted from the Huang family.
The accumulation of a family can amount to millions of taels of assets.
The head of the family waved his hand, and the servants of Feng Mansion guarded the courtyard, and received at least ten taels of silver as a reward, and as many as five hundred taels.
Chen Yun and the fourth master of the Feng family were in the accounting room distributing money, and they were busy all morning without touching the floor.
Chen Yun also received a reward. He and Su Waner received three hundred taels in total, he received two hundred and Su Waner received one hundred.
After a busy morning, he felt a little unreal.
The Qianlong Mountains are over!
Several major aristocratic families in the city shook hands with the city lord's mansion to make peace! !
From now on, the Feng family may be respected in the city! ! ?
The news exploded one after another.
In Findian City, it was said that the eldest lady of the Feng family wiped out the Huang family with one sword, and then it was said that Feng Luoyi blew her breath and killed all the Huang family.
The more it spreads, the more evil it becomes.
But no matter what happens, the Feng family is the biggest winner in the Qianlong Mountains.
"The changes have been too great. The eldest lady is back. Is she so strong?"
Shen Yun found out the details of last night and was still a little unbelievable.
The sword points at the seven ancestors and destroys the sea of ​​blood with one sword!
Thinking of Feng Luoyi, Chen Yun unconsciously looked towards the corner of the accounting room.
In the past, she liked to listen to Shen Yun telling stories, from fables to ancient myths that he magically modified.
The little girl who sat in the corner and listened quietly to his stories fifteen years ago has now reached this situation.
What did others do in fifteen years? What did he do in fifteen years?
After the fourth master left, Shen Yun couldn't wait to come to the opposite side and asked Old Man Feng for confirmation.
"Old man Feng, the eldest lady..."
As a result, he opened the door and found old man Feng sitting there blankly, crying.
"...What's going on?"
The whole person seemed to have aged ten years, his original gray hair was all white, and his face was full of fatigue and sadness.
"Old Shen, Xiaotian is crippled, his cultivation is crippled, one-third of his bones are broken, and he will never be able to stand up again for the rest of his life!"
Old Man Feng's eyes were dull and he was muttering.
"What! Fengtian..."
Chen Yun thought of the honest and honest Feng Tian. He had hugged him when he was a child and told him stories about strange creatures and legends.
Fengtian later became a monk and the squad leader, and he has always respected him.
